label: The sharp fideist bundle is jointly satisfiable: some practice satisfies both
meaning: The sharp fideist bundle is consistent: a one-move practice satisfies the internal-grammar thesis and the cut-off thesis, which bind-check matches to the conjuncts of WittgensteinianFideism. So the rival does not lose on coherence; its defeat for the Catholic practice (WF-FAILS-AS-DESCRIPTION-OF-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE) comes from that practice's own rule. Answer map in TruthCore/Comparison/Fideism.lean and docs/wittgenstein.md. The model does not show that fideism is true of any actual practice.
